notes: Godot 4.7 playable desktop-companion settlement game (Tiny Ages v0.1.0) by Hung Tran. Project lives in src/game/. Custom project icon src/game/icon.png (md5 b06a406310e6bf7ce89b4981d8718f93), not the Godot default. Font: Pixelify Sans, SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL text bundled at src/game/assets/fonts/PixelifySans-OFL.txt). Pixel art, writing, and code are original to the project (MIT), per src/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Includes the MIT-licensed Godot AI editor plugin under src/game/addons/godot_ai/ (development tooling). No Git LFS, no default Godot icon, no editor .godot, no signing keystore.
